title: Abnormal cases on the network side

entities.name: Timer T3486
entities.description: Timer used during EPS bearer context modification procedure. On expiry, the MME resends MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST and restarts timer. After fifth expiry, procedure is aborted.

entities.name: EPS bearer context modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure for modifying EPS bearer context parameters initiated by the network.

entities.name: MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by MME to UE to request modification of EPS bearer context parameters.

entities.name: BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE
entities.description: State entered by MME after aborting EPS bearer context modification procedure due to timer T3486 expiry.

entities.name: UE requested PDN disconnect procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to disconnect a PDN connection.

entities.name: PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request disconnection of a PDN connection.

entities.name: UE requested bearer resource modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to modify bearer resources.

entities.name: BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request modification of bearer resources.

entities.name: BEARER CONTEXT MODIFY PENDING
entities.description: State during EPS bearer context modification procedure where modification is pending.

entities.name: Collision with PDN disconnect procedure
entities.description: Condition when MME receives PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST during EPS bearer context modification for same PDN connection.

entities.name: Collision with bearer resource modification procedure
entities.description: Condition when MME receives BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST during EPS bearer context modification for same bearer.

entities.name: Procedure abortion
entities.description: Property indicating procedure termination due to abnormal conditions like timer expiry or collision.

relations.description: EPS bearer context modification procedure starts timer T3486.
EPS bearer context modification procedure includes sending MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.
On T3486 expiry, MME resends MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST and resets timer.
Fifth expiry of T3486 establishes procedure abortion.
Procedure abortion establishes transition to BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE state.
Collision with PDN disconnect procedure establishes local termination of EPS bearer modification.
Condition triggered by receiving PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST message.
Condition triggered by receiving BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message.
Collision condition requires BEARER CONTEXT MODIFY PENDING state.
PDN disconnect procedure includes receiving PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST message.
Bearer resource modification procedure includes receiving BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message.
